recent.statement: The Strait of Hormuz will see increased ship transits within the next week
recent.evidence: The only Strait of Hormuz signal shows 15 daily transits, 30% below its 30-day average of 21, indicating decreased rather than increased transits.

recent.statement: The Strait of Hormuz will see an increase in ship transits by more than 30% above its 30-day average within the next week
recent.evidence: The only Strait of Hormuz signal shows 15 daily transits, 30% below its 30-day average of 21, far from a 30%+ increase.

recent.statement: A magnitude 6.0 earthquake will occur within the next week
recent.evidence: No captured signal reports any magnitude 6.0 earthquake during the window, and an event of that size would have been captured, so the forecast is not verified.

recent.statement: The price of Brent Crude will drop by 5% within the next week
recent.evidence: The only Brent price signal shows Brent at $86.87/bbl with just a -1.69% move, far short of a 5% weekly decline, and no signal indicates such a drop occurred before the window closed.

recent.statement: A significant earthquake will occur within the next week in a region with high population density.
recent.evidence: No captured signal reports any significant earthquake in a densely populated region during the 2026-07-21 to 2026-07-28 window, so the forecast is unsupported.

recent.statement: The Strait of Hormuz will experience an increase in ship transits by at least 20% above its 30-day average within the next week
recent.evidence: The only Strait of Hormuz signal shows 15 daily transits, 30% below its 30-day average of 21, rather than at least 20% above it.

recent.statement: Tropical cyclone TWO-26 will make landfall within the next week
recent.evidence: No signal names tropical cyclone TWO-26 or reports its landfall within the window; the only Atlantic-basin entry (BERTHA-26) is a green alert showing no significant wind impact, which is a status rather than evidence of TWO-26 making landfall.

recent.statement: The price of Brent Crude will fall by 3% within the next week
recent.evidence: The only Brent price signal shows a mere -0.85% daily move to $87.61/bbl at window close, with no signal indicating a 3% decline over the week.

recent.statement: There will be at least one earthquake of magnitude 5.8 or higher in the next week.
recent.evidence: The window closed on 2026-07-27 and no archived signal reports any earthquake of magnitude 5.8 or higher, so the occurrence is not shown by the admissible evidence.

recent.statement: The Strait of Hormuz will see an increase in ship transits within the next week
recent.evidence: Strait of Hormuz shows 15 daily transits, 30% below its 30-day average, indicating a decrease rather than the forecasted increase.

recent.statement: The Strait of Hormuz will experience a significant increase in ship transits within the next week
recent.evidence: The only Strait of Hormuz signal shows 15 daily transits, 30% below its 30-day average, indicating a decrease rather than a significant increase.

recent.statement: A severe thunderstorm warning will be issued for the Midwest region within the next week
recent.evidence: S2 shows a Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued by NWS Chicago IL on July 27, within the Midwest region and inside the forecast window.
